title: Customer install observations and asks - 2026-06-30
summary: Standup + deep-dive for Acadia Health private deployment. Captures reproducible networking symptom, certificate rotation mismatch, missing node-level telemetry, and prioritized asks for field engineering and SRE to unblock go-live.
body:
Context: This is the sprint-44 field-sync focused on Acadia Health's VPC + on-prem edge cluster. Customer is on a hybrid topology: private VPC in us-east-1 with an on-prem DMZ terminating a transit VPN. We have a staged install progressing through: control-plane bootstrap -> model artifact sync -> runtime validation. Current state: control plane up, model sync completed for small models, inference runtime flaps intermittently under load. Key symptoms observed during the call:

1) Networking: inter-zone path MTU mismatch between Acadia's VPN appliance and AWS Transit gateway. Observed packet fragmentation leading to gRPC timeouts. Repro steps: run grpc-client with message size 256KB across VPN, 30% of calls fail with UNAVAILABLE, tcpdump shows IP fragments dropped at appliance. Temporary mitigation: lower gRPC max message size to 128KB and enable path-mtu discovery on customer gateway. Long-term ask: customer to coordinate with network vendor to allow DF=0 or raise MTU to 9001.

2) TLS cert rotation mismatch: Control plane rotated the cert for agent-heartbeat but edge nodes still using older CA chain. This produces 401s from node heartbeats and causes autoscaler to intermittently mark pods NotReady. Repro steps: trigger rotation in staging, watch node-agent logs for tls_verify failed. Fix applied during call: manual upload of intermediate cert to /var/lib/redwood/agent/ca.pem on affected nodes. Ask: add explicit cert-rotation orchestration task in installer and a post-rotation healthcheck that validates agent->control-plane TLS handshake.

3) KMS/HSM integration nuance: Acadia is using an HSM-backed KMS with a policy that disallows DescribeKey from non-management principals. Our installer attempts DescribeKey during bootstrap and fails the provisioning check, which the script currently treats as fatal. Mitigation: made installer allow DescribeKey failure to be non-fatal and perform a crypto-primitives test (encrypt/decrypt) with the management role. Ask: update installer to support a non-DescribeKey verification path and document required roles in the runbook.

4) Runtime flapping under burst: observed GPU/worker OOM due to unexpected model shard placement. Symptoms: pod restarts at ~2.5k tokens/sec sustained for 30s. Investigation: kubelet eviction thresholds and pod QoS interplay with transient memory spikes from quantized kernels. Temporary fix: increased pod memory request by 25% on the model-inference daemonset and bumped eviction threshold for GPU nodes. Ask: eng-serving-runtime to provide guidance on memory headroom for quantized int8 kernels; update recommended resource profiles in console defaults.

5) Missing telemetry: customer noticed that token-level latency traces were missing for 10k+ requests across a 6-hour window. Root cause likely: log rotation policy on on-prem forwarder truncated traces before they reached our aggregator during a restart window. Ask: add a buffered-forwarder mode to the onprem agent that persists up to 1 hour of telemetry on disk and resumes on connectivity restore. Also request SRE to define retention emergency endpoints for hot-upload.

6) Healthcheck flapping on port 50051: Load balancer marks runtime unhealthy due to intermittent TCP RSTs. Packet analysis suggests ephemeral NAT port exhaustion on the customer's NAT gateway. Ask: customer to audit ephemeral port usage and increase ephemeral port range and/or NAT pool size for pods that perform high connection churn.

Notes and side-discussions captured during meeting: we ran a quick reproduction with a local harness (Ethan) that reproduced the MTU fragment drop; Nadia validated cert fix on two nodes; Priya sketched a runbook patch to add post-rotation checks and a documented rollback procedure. Customer provided a temporary use-case waiver to run with reduced max message size on prod while vendor addresses MTU.

Open risks: If cert rotation occurs during an autoscaler event, we risk a longer partial outage because agents may be repeatedly marked Unhealthy and restarted. If HSM policy changes upstream, installs in other customers with strict KMS policies may fail similarly.

Decisions made: 1) implement non-fatal DescribeKey path in installer to allow HSM-only flows; 2) modify post-rotation job to validate agent handshake; 3) create a buffered-forwarder MVP for onprem agent with 1 hour disk buffer.

Next steps during field window: schedule a vendor call (customer+network vendor+Redwood SRE) for MTU resolution, target date 2026-07-06. Patch installer and release test candidate by 2026-07-02. Deploy buffered-forwarder alpha to Acadia staging 2026-07-05.

Unresolved questions for product/engineering leadership:
- Policy for treating DescribeKey failures as fatal vs informational for other managed KMS vendors?
- Standard memory headroom guidance for quantized models across our catalog?
- Do we want to add an optional cert-rotation cross-check in control plane by default or opt-in per deployment?

Misc: referenced Slack threads and a small pcap saved to the shared drive at /shared_drives/engineering/private-deployments/acadia-pcap-2026-06-30.pcap
action_items: Ethan Brooks: produce minimal reproduction harness (MTU fragment case) and upload pcap to shared drive by 2026-07-01
Nadia Singh: patch installer to tolerate DescribeKey failure and implement encrypt/decrypt check; open PR and link to JIRA-ENG-5723 by 2026-07-02
Omar Castillo: add post-rotation agent handshake healthcheck to runbook and installer job; draft runbook diff by 2026-07-02
Priya Desai: prototype buffered-forwarder alpha (1 hour disk buffer) and coordinate staging deploy on 2026-07-05
Leah Martinez: coordinate vendor call with Acadia + network vendor + SRE for MTU resolution on 2026-07-06; prepare agenda and reproduction notes
Customer (Mei Chen): increase ephemeral port range or NAT pool and confirm change result by 2026-07-04
